messages:
maria-billing: FYI — customer 'Helix Media' flagged an invoice mismatch. They requested invoices in EUR for the EU legal entity but the system issued USD invoice under the US entity. PO PO-9482 required by their AP team. Invoice #98765 attached. They refused payment due to VAT rounding difference.

sam-support: Can you paste the invoice creation payload or API call that led to this? Also need payment attempt id and decline code if any.

customer-rep: They tried to pay yesterday. Decline came back with code 402 (currency_mismatch). They included PO and said they will only accept EUR invoices with local VAT breakdown.

maria-billing: attaching the minimal repro — our billing service call used by checkout: ```POST /v1/invoices```
{
  "customer_id": "cust_helix",
  "entity": "redwood-us",
  "currency": "USD",
  "lines": [{"desc":"API usage","amount_cents":123456}],
  "metadata": {"po":"PO-9482"}
}

invoices-bot: Invoice 98765 created by redwood-us, net 1234.56 USD, tax 246.91 USD -> total 1481.47 USD.

jules-finance: Root cause looks like entity selection. The customer is on EU legal entity (redwood-eu) but the checkout flow falls back to default entity. redwood-eu invoices must be EUR and apply line-level VAT rounding rules (per-country). USD->EUR FX + invoice-level rounding caused 0.03 EUR VAT delta that triggered their AP.

irina-accounting: For regulated invoices we need: 1) invoice currency = entity currency, 2) VAT shown per-line with cents rounded per local law. Current pipeline does currency conversion post-tax which is wrong.

sam-support: Short-term customer fix? Can we reissue invoice in EUR and apply credit note for the USD invoice?

maria-billing: Yes. Proposed immediate actions: - Reissue invoice #98765 as EUR under redwood-eu (use FX snapshot at 2025-03-10 14:12 UTC) - Create credit note for USD invoice and link to PO PO-9482 - Push payment retry link to customer once EUR invoice is sent.

jules-finance: I can do the credit note and reissue manually. Need the FX rate to use and approval for rounding policy override.

irina-accounting: Use FX 0.912345 (our finance snapshot). For legal compliance, round VAT per-line to 2 decimals, then sum. Approve manual override for this single case — I sign off.

sam-support: I'll message the customer with ETA and a new payment link once invoices are posted.

maria-billing: Thanks. Long-term fix: billing service must pick entity by customer legal_entity or workspace setting at invoice creation time, and accept an optional currency param that is validated against entity currency. Also update tax calc to do per-line rounding with entity-specific rules.

jules-finance: For engineering owners: @sam-support will file a billing bug with replication steps and attach this thread. @maria-billing to include list of affected customers (query: invoices where entity != customer.entity && currency != entity.currency).

sam-support: I'll create the ticket now and link to this thread. Blocking priority: P1 for multi-entity customers in EU.

maria-billing: Postmortem note: include customer impact (payment delayed), manual credit issued, and the remediation timeline (hotfix to enforce entity currency + config for rounding within 2 business days).

customer-rep: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please confirm when EUR invoice is available and include the PO on the PDF header.

jules-finance: Confirmed — I'll attach PO to the reissued invoice and cc customer contacts.

invoices-bot: Action log: created credit_note CN-201 for invoice 98765, reissued invoice 98765-R in EUR as 1126.78 EUR (tax 204.56 EUR). Linked PO-9482.

maria-billing: Closing loop: owners and tasks — Jules: do credit & reissue (ETA 2h). Sam: create engineering ticket + repro (ETA 1h). Irina: approve rounding override (done). I'll follow up with customer when reissue is live.

sam-support: Ticket created: BILL-4321 — includes payload + bank of failing invoices. Assigning to eng-billing.

customer-rep: Received the EUR invoice and payment link. Processing now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
